summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY, focused on Edge AI and Computer Vision. Deployed TensorRT YOLO on embedded NVIDIA Jetson, cutting latency from 56.7 to 10.9 ms (5.2x). Strong Python programming and C/C++ programming, debugging and performance profiling, training and evaluating CV models in PyTorch, and quantization, model conversion, inference optimization on GPU.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.
Curated and annotated a custom toothbrush detection dataset for health-level classification using YOLOv8.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU; reported accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% by fine-tuning DONUT, a vision transformer, with improved preprocessing and model tuning.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Deployed TensorRT-optimized YOLO on NVIDIA Jetson for visual servoing: 5.2× speedup (56.7→10.9 ms, 17.6→92 FPS vs eager PyTorch), alongside faster-whisper STT and dual VL53L0X ToF sensors for contact-aware grasping.
Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.
Deployed the Jetson-side bridge as a systemd service (auto-restart, non-root isolation) with static IP networking; configured XRDP remote administration of the headless Jetson.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled peak VRAM and inference latency across prompt types using pynvml and psutil.
Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC; <1% accuracy degradation with +0.09 perplexity increase, evaluating efficiency vs task performance for edge deployment constraints.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built automated data generation pipelines using CARLA's semantic segmentation and raycast occlusion filtering to produce ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD training frames with zero manual annotation.
Trained YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18); validated in Town02 with 30 vehicles and 10 pedestrians with zero collisions.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript conv layers in VGG16 with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing and constant memory; coalesced kernel ran at 49.2ms vs 73.3ms uncoalesced and 77.5ms CPU TorchScript (~35% speedup) with identical accuracy.
